title: Carbon Trap Shino Workshop with Joe Hicks
source_quote: Carbon Trap Shino Workshop District Clay Center September 18, 1 - 5 pm Register Here Join us for the return of our in-depth exploration with Joe Hicks of that most exciting and dynamic of glazes, CARBON TRAP SHINO.
evidence_sentence: The workshop guides participants through making and applying Shino glazes, then loading work into District Clay's reduction kiln for special carbon trap firing.
evidence_quote: You will then glaze your work choosing between four Shino glazes and then load it into District Clay's reduction kiln for special carbon trap firing Saturday night.
summary: Learn to make and apply carbon trap shino glazes with Joe Hicks, then fire your work in a reduction kiln the same night; attend a kiln opening three days later to retrieve your pots.
how_to_join: Register via the District Clay Center website
commitment: Saturday 1-5 pm, plus Tuesday kiln opening
